case.must_observe.1.rationale: Actual archive hashes equal both versioned SHA256SUMS and the inspected manifest snapshot. All three names/directory, registry version and license-application declaration are 1.1.0; README/INSTALL/platform-guidance local targets resolve, with host runtime verification still false.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Controlling license/notice/provenance and original/derived logo bytes are identical to baseline. Only license-application release version/date changed. Root read the canonical resources and provenance notices: authored methods, paraphrases and official-source pointers, no imported full standards/library texts or real business fixture data. The separate bounded secret-pattern scan found no matching filenames within its documented limits; no blanket security or rights certification is inferred.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Registry dependencies remains empty, Document-Evidence instructions are optional handoff only, and its installed skill is absent from the 49-file archive inventory. The actual checker and local builder do not write installed skill directories; installation and external publication were not performed.

limitations: Actual static checks plus root content review; not model behavior, installation, platform verification or third-party assurance.
ZIPs intentionally have different root/metadata/hash. Content parity is normalized per manifest, not whole-archive equality.
Bounded pattern scan and provenance review do not certify absence of every secret, malware or third-party-rights issue.
